aggro_perception_range.fact: Creatures have a flat 20-tile Perception Range (2026-08-12 patch; replaced the per-wave aggro range increase).

creature_movement_speed.fact: Wiki Creatures List gives only a categorical Speed per creature (VerySlow/Slow/Medium/Fast/VeryFast; stored per creature as `speed`). No tiles-per-second or step-delay values for these categories were found in the knowledge base; any numeric mapping is [INFERENCE]. Tamed/summoned creatures in Attack/Patrol/Guard mode had their speed reduced to 'previous levels' (2018).
missing: seconds per step for each Speed category

creature_attack_speed.fact: Every creature's AtkSpd on the wiki is '?'. A tamed/summoned creature's base Attack Speed is 3.0 seconds per attack (2021-04-09 taming overhaul), with a -5%..+5% spawn scalar for tamed creatures (other stats -10%..+10%); attack-speed upgrades are % scalars. Follower attack-speed bonuses above the cap become damage bonus (#4661); cap reported as 50% per pet, uncertain (#1957). Wild creature swing delay not documented; using 3.0 s for them is [INFERENCE].

player_swing_speed_formula.fact: Player swing delay = Weapon Base Swing Speed * (1 - Swing Speed Increase); base speed formula 15000 / ((Current Stamina (max 100) + 100) * Weapon Speed). Excess swing speed over the cap converts 1:1 into damage bonus vs creatures.

barding_success_chance.fact: Barding Success Chance = (Effective Barding Skill / 100) - (CreatureDifficulty * 1%). Minimum Success Chance = 33% * (Effective Barding Skill / 100) (2024-12-10; was 25% * skill/100 in the 2020 patch); the higher of the two is used. Barding skill is capped by Musicianship. Bonus +25 effective skill when Discording/Pacifying a creature already Provoked/Pacified/Discorded; +12.5 per already-barded creature for Provocation. With our 80 skill vs Mausoleum difficulties (17.8-169.3) the calculated chance is mostly <=0, so the 26.4% minimum (33% * 0.8) applies for difficulty >= ~53.6 [arithmetic from the formulas; Musicianship and instrument bonuses unknown].

barding_break.fact: While a non-boss creature is Provoked or Pacified, each second there is a (CreatureDifficulty/100)*1% chance of a Barding Break lasting CreatureDifficulty/10 seconds: Provocation and Peacemaking (not Discordance) end at once, the creature is immune to Provoke/Peace during the break and suffers -50% Attack Speed, -50% Casting Speed, +50% delay between abilities. When the break ends the creature has a moderate aggro bonus toward the bard for 10 s. A bard who barded it in the last 60 s gets a Break Barrier (damage and damage-resistance bonus of 20% * highest printed barding skill [as written]) vs creatures in a break.

discordance_effect.fact: Discorded debuff: +25% damage taken from all sources (multiplicative) and -25% damage dealt, scaled by (bard's printed Discordance / 120): 80 Discordance -> 16.67% (wiki example rounds to 16%). 50% effectiveness on mini-bosses, 40% on bosses. Discorded creatures that are Pacified or Provoked take an additional 15% damage. Provoked creatures do not suffer the damage-dealt penalty. Shows '*discorded Xs*' overhead on AllNames.

discordance_duration_cooldown.fact: Discordance skill cooldown 5 s on success and failure (also applies a 5 s cooldown to Provocation/Peacemaking). Duration: patch 2020-04-07 says (Effective Barding Skill/100) * 60 s (x2 of Provoke/Peace); the wiki skill page says ((60 s - Creature Difficulty) * (Effective Barding Skill/100)) with minimum 15 * (Musicianship/100) s. The two sources conflict; the wiki page is the newer text [INFERENCE which applies]. Max 15 s against tamed creatures.

peacemaking_duration_cooldown.fact: Peacemaking cooldown 10 s on success, 5 s on failure (may alternate with Discordance every 5 s). Pacified creatures cannot move, attack or use most abilities. Duration: wiki ((60 s - Creature Difficulty) * (Effective Barding Skill/100)), minimum 15 * (Musicianship/100) s; 2020 patch text says (Effective Barding Skill/100) * 30 s, no difficulty reduction. Pacifying a Provoked creature overrides the provoke. Area Peacemaking by targeting self (same cooldowns, separate check per creature).

provocation_duration_cooldown.fact: Provocation cooldown 10 s on success, 5 s on failure. Duration: wiki ((60 s - highest creature difficulty) * (Effective Barding Skill/100)), minimum 15 * (Musicianship/100) s; 2020 patch: (Effective Barding Skill/100) * 30 s. Provoked creatures deal +500% damage to other creatures (damage 100% of normal per 2018 patch, superseded). Max range for keeping provocation is 40 tiles (2026-09-04; older: within 50 tiles / tether skill/2). Tamed creatures cannot be provoked.

pet_commands_guard_kill.fact: All Guard: pets guard you and attack whatever attacks you; guarding stops on a transition (recall/dungeon level). Guarding pets take aggro from mobs within about 10 tiles, though a mob still targets you if you are the only one in range. All Kill: pets attack the selected target; if you are within range the monster attacks you first (counts as your aggression); after the kill pets return to Follow mode unless given another target. Other commands: All Patrol, All Stop, All Stay, All Follow (no attacking), All Come; 'All' can be replaced by a pet name.

veterinary_supplies.fact: Double-clicking Veterinary Supplies heals all friendly followers within 2 tiles after the normal Veterinary bandage time (5 s for followers, healing speed always as 100 Dex), at 50% of bandage healing (75% if only one creature is affected); cure/resurrect chances scale the same; the player also gets 25% bandage effectiveness. Cancels/blocks bandages. Base bandage healing on creatures is 80-120 (2022-06-07). Followers get a damage bonus of 10% * (Effective Veterinary/100).

stationary_bandaging.fact: After standing still 5 s players may bandage targets up to 2 tiles away; moving within 5 s of finishing the bandage reverts the range to 1 tile.

heal_potions.fact: Heal Potion heals 20-35 (15-25 PvP-flagged); Lesser Heal Potion heals 15-25 (10-15 PvP). Heal potions have a 10 s cooldown; 'some damage has been healed' system message marks the drink. No Greater Heal potion amount was found (Greater Heal spell: 45-60).

stationary_penalty.fact: After a Recall/Gate/Hike, or standing still for 5 minutes or more, a Stationary Damage Penalty reduces all damage dealt to creatures by the player AND their followers to 1; removed after walking or running 5 steps; a system message announces it. Not applied on ships or vs Battletrainers.

mausoleum_layout.fact: The Mausoleum is one of the Outlands dungeons; Level 4 is the Darkscale Tomb (opened 2023-05-28; Vampire Primogen live there). No level-by-level layout or spawn table was found in the knowledge base; all creature pages listed here give Location 'The Mausoleum'. Capture evidence: arrival from the rune at 5605,708 and fighting at x 5180-5290, y 640-740 on facet 0 (session_20261012_210013).

bleed.fact: Follower Bleed (e.g. Vampire Bat): 15% chance on melee hit to inflict (DamageMax * 1.0) bleed damage over 15 s. Bleed resolves in ticks every 3 s for 15 s, each tick 20% of the total (swordsmanship page). Bleeds stack. Higher-level creatures may have Special Resistance giving a chance to ignore bleed/disease ticks. No bleed or life-drain special for the (wild) Vampire, Vampire Countess, Elder Vampire, Elder Vampire Countess or Vampiric Consort was found in the knowledge base.

disease.fact: Disease effects tick every 5 s over 20 s (2023-05-22). Follower Disease: 15% chance on melee hit to inflict (DamageMax * 0.5) disease damage per tick. Disease stacks.

creature_damage_resistance.fact: Since the 2026-08-11 patch non-follower creatures have a small Damage Resistance that varies by creature and largely scales with Difficulty Value; exact values not given.

creature_difficulty_meaning.fact: Creature Difficulty (shown by Animal Lore to everyone) determines loot, barding difficulty and other mechanics. [INFERENCE from the pages above] wiki Gold Value is about 10 x Difficulty for every creature listed.

underdog_bonus.fact: Tamed followers get an Underdog Bonus to Wrestling, max +20%, scaled by the gap between the creature's Min Taming and 120 (wiki 'Underdog Scalar' column: gravebug 1.028, phoenix 1).

player_regeneration.fact: Players regenerate 1 hit point every 4 s and 1 stamina every 2 s passively.

data_notes.fact: Creature numbers come from the wiki creature page (knowledge id = first entry) and the wiki 'Creatures List' row (second id) which adds Parry, Magery, Spell Damage, AI, Speed and Unique Scaler; both agree on every shared field (checked). Extra per-creature fields beyond the requested schema: magery, parry, speed (wiki category), unique_scaler, stealth (wiki 'X'), attack_speed (always null: wiki '?'), location, capture (replay evidence). capture.named_serials_in_area: distinct serials with a known name, notoriety 3-6, inside x 5150-5650 y 600-760, facet 0 in session_20261012_210013; capture.deaths: mobile_death events whose corpse is named '<name> corpse' over the whole session. Names are not always known before death, so serial counts undercount (vampiric consort and blightmare were killed but never named while in view). In-game corpse name 'an apparation corpse' vs mobile name 'an apparition' (wiki: Apparition) -> key 'apparition' with alias. Captured mobile hits are a share of 100 for monsters and pets, so absolute hits come only from the wiki. Wild-creature special abilities are not in the knowledge base; specials listed are the tamed follower abilities of the same species, labelled [INFERENCE] for wild use.
